about_the_game:
In this minimalist tower defense game, bullets are not just weapons—they are resources.
You must produce bullets through defense towers and use various buildings to transport, split, accelerate, or transform them, creating your own automated bullet factory.

Enemies won’t attack directly but instead interfere with your defenses through special abilities:

  • Some disable nearby towers upon death;

  • Some dash forward, ignore slows, or rapidly respawn;

  • You’ll need to plan towers and buildings carefully to counter different enemy types across each path.

Features

  • Bullet Automation: Produce, transport, and process bullets—efficient use is the key to survival.

  • Varied Buildings: Redirect bullets, split them, speed them up, or even recycle them for continuous use.

  • Unique Enemy Design: Each path features different enemy types, forcing adaptive strategies.

  • Diverse Maps: From compact arenas to sprawling multi-path layouts, each map demands new solutions.

  • This is a game about construction and planning—not just stacking towers, but ensuring every bullet flows where it’s needed.
    Can your defense factory hold out until the end?

name: 图标塔防

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 或同等 AMD 处理器
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 630 / AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: 集成声卡即可
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 或 AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 集成声卡即可

short_description: 《图标塔防》是一款将子弹本身作为资源的自动化塔防游戏，你不仅需要建造防御塔，还需要使用建筑来运输，分流，甚至改造子弹来应对不同特性的敌人。每一条子弹产线的构筑都至关重要，你准备好迎接挑战了吗？
